copy_policy: Exact source bytes; source and snapshot SHA-256 are identical.
scope: PE mainline 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-27 plus route frozen 2026-10-29; PA6 documents are unexecuted extension plans.
excluded: Literature PDFs and downloaded third-party source trees
Binary wavefunctions, trajectories and restart files
Large per-iteration records and full original GPAW convergence jobs
Personal discussion inputs, screen captures, process monitoring and machine credentials
limitations: Historical scripts retain original paths and source-hash guards; configure a relocated working copy before reruns.
The snapshot is a curated source and terminal-evidence archive, not a complete byte-for-byte workspace backup.
External engines and PAW datasets require their own installation; binaries are not bundled.
Some original manifests refer to excluded intermediate artifacts; those references document provenance and are not claimed to be included.
